name: Siren Slide
author: Vocal Monitor
description: The pedagogue's favourite warm-up: a smooth 'siren' glissando line sweeps up and down your range and you slide your voice to ride it. Trains blending chest, mix and head registers without a break. Your live pitch is a glowing puck with a comet trail - green where you hug the line, red where you slip off. Set your own low/high notes and slide speed; the on-target percentage and streak timer track how cleanly you ride the swoops.
